title: Create: Linked Thrusters - VS2 Edition
description: Adds new thrusters and a flap bearing to VS2 all with build in redstone link functionality.
body:
![Thrusters thrusting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tr4shyyy/Linked-Thrusters/refs/heads/master/media/thrusties_1.gif)

Add's new thrusters (all with built in redstone link functionality) to Valkyrien Skies 2.
*   Liquid Thruster
*   Commercial Jet Engine
*   Creative Thruster

Liquid thruster and Commercial Jet Engine works with vanilla lava as well as liquid fuels from various Create mods.

Also adds the Linked Flap Bearing that has the same linking functionality.

![Linked Thrusters flap instruction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tr4shyyy/Linked-Thrusters/refs/heads/master/media/linked_flap_instruct.gif)

**SHIFT + RIGHT CLICK** on a linking block brings up the frequency GUI which works the same as a redstone link.

This mod is very early in development. If you find problems please let me know.
